race.comment: Connections had such a high opinion of OREGON COAST (10) that they debuted her in a G3 contest at Rosehill where she certainly wasn't disgraced. Backed that up with a runner-up finish behind a pretty smart one and has since joined the new stable. Revved up for this with two recent trials and can run a big race while fresh. IRREVERENT (2) just missed the frame at Eagle Farm when resuming and will have come on with that run now in the locker. Gets the reliable Gollan/Maloney combination and looms as the main danger. STEVIE'S SPIRIT (12) is facing the starter for the first time but has shown ability at the trials and should get a gun run in transit from the inside marble. Include in calculations. KOBABILITY (3) has placed two of four over this distance range and strips fitter second-up from the spell. One for the multiples.
